task_spec: Implement a rate limiter that allows at most `limit` requests within ANY `window_secs`-second sliding interval (no interval of that length may ever contain more than `limit` allowed requests).

bugs.description: This is a FIXED-window counter, not a sliding window. It permits a burst of up to 2*limit requests across a window boundary: `limit` requests just before window_start+window_secs, then the counter resets and `limit` more immediately after — all within a single window_secs interval. The spec requires no window_secs interval ever exceed `limit`. A correct implementation needs a sliding log or token bucket.

provenance.note: subtle bug requiring reasoning/domain knowledge to catch
